ModMetaData.name: RimMT Clean Pathfinding A2.6 - Region Link Guard
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: Preserves the exact FinishFrame Touch endpoint correction and repairs RegionCostCalculator at its source: a RegionLink whose opposite Region is null is rejected before Region.Allows can dereference it. Four exact RegionCostCalculator methods are guarded; if Clean Pathfinding's native region-distance fix is already installed, this guard yields to it. PathFinder, StartPath, Root_Play, Diagnostics, caches, queues and per-frame code are untouched.
